files.shabads/19/9719.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":9719,"source_id":"D","writer_id":47,"raag_id":63,"page_no":817,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":5,"first_verse_id":110553,"last_verse_id":110557,"source_english":"Dasam Bani","source_unicode":"ਦਸਮ ਬਾਣੀ","writer":"Guru Gobind Singh Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":null,"raag_unicode":null},"verses":[{"verse_id":110553,"page_no":817,"line_no":110553,"gurmukhi":"ਅੜਿਲ ॥","translit_en":"aRil ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Arril"},"pu":{"ss":"ਅੜਿਲ:"}}},{"verse_id":110554,"page_no":817,"line_no":110554,"gurmukhi":"ਤੁਮਰੋ ਕਰੋ ਇਲਾਜ ਨ ਹਾਸੀ ਜਾਨਿਯੋ ॥","translit_en":"tumaro karo ilaaj na haasee jaaniyo ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"‘I will get you treated  there is nothing to laugh at."},"pu":{"ss":"(ਵੈਦ ਬਣੇ ਆਦਮੀ ਨੇ ਕਿਹਾ) ਮੈਂ ਤੁਹਾਡਾ ਇਲਾਜ ਕਰਾਗਾ, ਇਸ ਵਿਚ ਕੋਈ ਹਾਸੀ ਦੀ ਗੱਲ ਨਹੀਂ।"}}},{"verse_id":110555,"page_no":818,"line_no":110555,"gurmukhi":"ਰੋਗ ਹੇਤ ਅਨੁਸਰੌ ਬੁਰੈ ਮਤਿ ਮਾਨਿਯੋ ॥","translit_en":"rog het anusarau burai mat maaniyo ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"‘One should not refrain  the treatment must match the disease and one should not desist."},"pu":{"ss":"(ਮੈਂ) ਰੋਗ ਦੇ ਅਨੁਸਾਰ ਇਲਾਜ ਕਰਦਾ ਹਾ; (ਤੁਸੀਂ) ਬੁਰਾ ਨਾ ਮੰਨਣਾ।"}}},{"verse_id":110556,"page_no":818,"line_no":110556,"gurmukhi":"ਬੈਦ ਧਾਇ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਤ ਤੇ ਭੇਦ ਦੁਰਾਇਯੈ ॥","translit_en":"baidh dhai gur mit te bhedh dhuraiyai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"‘One should not keep ailment in secret from a vaid, a midwife, a guru and a friend."},"pu":{"ss":"ਵੈਦ, ਦਾਈ, ਗੁਰੂ, ਮਿਤਰ ਤੋਂ (ਜੇ) ਭੇਦ ਲੁਕਾ ਲਈਏ,"}}},{"verse_id":110557,"page_no":818,"line_no":110557,"gurmukhi":"ਹੋ ਕਹੌ ਕਵਨ ਕੇ ਆਗੇ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਜਨਾਇਯੈ ॥੭॥","translit_en":"ho kahau kavan ke aage birathaa janaiyai ||7||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"‘There is no one else to whom we could open our minds.’(7)"},"pu":{"ss":"ਤਾ ਦਸੋ, ਕਿਸ ਅਗੇ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਦੁਖ ਨੂੰ ਦਸੀਏ ॥੭॥"}}}],"nav":{"prev":9718,"next":9720}}

files.shabads/19/9809.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":9809,"source_id":"D","writer_id":47,"raag_id":63,"page_no":828,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":5,"first_verse_id":111124,"last_verse_id":111128,"source_english":"Dasam Bani","source_unicode":"ਦਸਮ ਬਾਣੀ","writer":"Guru Gobind Singh Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":null,"raag_unicode":null},"verses":[{"verse_id":111124,"page_no":828,"line_no":111124,"gurmukhi":"ਅੜਿਲ ॥","translit_en":"aRil ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Arril"},"pu":{"ss":"ਅੜਿਲ:"}}},{"verse_id":111125,"page_no":828,"line_no":111125,"gurmukhi":"ਤਬੈ ਰਾਇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਆਇ ਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਣ ਐਸੇ ਕਿਯੋ ॥","translit_en":"tabai rai gireh aai su pran aaise kiyo ||","translation":{"pu":{"ss":"ਤਦ ਰਾਜੇ ਨੇ ਘਰ ਪਹੁੰਚ ਕੇ ਇਸ ਤਰ੍ਰਹਾ ਪ੍ਰਣ ਕੀਤਾ"}}},{"verse_id":111126,"page_no":828,"line_no":111126,"gurmukhi":"ਭਲੇ ਜਤਨ ਸੌ ਰਾਖਿ ਧਰਮ ਅਬ ਮੈ ਲਿਯੋ ॥","translit_en":"bhale jatan sau raakh dharam ab mai liyo ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Arriving home, he thanked his luck for saving his Dharma this time and determined,"},"pu":{"ss":"ਕਿ ਮੈਂ ਹੁਣ ਚੰਗੇ ਯਤਨ ਨਾਲ ਆਪਣਾ ਧਰਮ ਬਚਾ ਲਿਆ ਹੈ।"}}},{"verse_id":111127,"page_no":828,"line_no":111127,"gurmukhi":"ਦੇਸ ਦੇਸ ਨਿਜੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਭਾ ਬਿਖੇਰਿਹੌ ॥","translit_en":"dhes dhes nij prabh kee prabhaa bikherihau ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"‘Now I will roam around different countries to spread God’s exaltations,"},"pu":{"ss":"(ਹੁਣ ਮੈਂ) ਦੇਸ ਦੇਸਾਤਰਾ ਵਿਚ ਆਪਣੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁਤਾ ਨੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਰਾਗਾ"}}},{"verse_id":111128,"page_no":828,"line_no":111128,"gurmukhi":"ਹੋ ਆਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਯਾ ਕਹ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਹੇਰਿਹੌ ॥੪੯॥","translit_en":"ho aan tirayaa keh bahur na kabahoo(n) herihau ||49||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"And swore never to heed to a strange (woman).(49)"},"pu":{"ss":"ਅਤੇ ਪਰਾਈ ਇਸਤਰੀ ਨੂੰ ਫਿਰ ਕਦੇ ਵੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਵੇਖਾਗਾ ॥੪੯॥"}}}],"nav":{"prev":9808,"next":9810}}
files.shabads/19/9810.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":9810,"source_id":"D","writer_id":47,"raag_id":63,"page_no":828,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":3,"first_verse_id":111129,"last_verse_id":111131,"source_english":"Dasam Bani","source_unicode":"ਦਸਮ ਬਾਣੀ","writer":"Guru Gobind Singh Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":null,"raag_unicode":null},"verses":[{"verse_id":111129,"page_no":828,"line_no":111129,"gurmukhi":"ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥","translit_en":"dhoharaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Dohira"},"pu":{"ss":"ਦੋਹਰਾ:"}}},{"verse_id":111130,"page_no":828,"line_no":111130,"gurmukhi":"ਵਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਤਗ੍ਰਯਾ ਤਦਿਨ ਤੇ ਬ੍ਯਾਪਤ ਮੋ ਹਿਯ ਮਾਹਿ ॥","translit_en":"vahai pratagrayaa tadhin te bayaapat mo hiy maeh ||","translation":{"pu":{"ss":"ਉਸ ਦਿਨ ਦੀ ਉਹ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਗਿਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਵਿਚ ਵਿਆਪਤ ਹੈ।"}}},{"verse_id":111131,"page_no":829,"line_no":111131,"gurmukhi":"ਤਾ ਦਿਨ ਤੇ ਪਰ ਨਾਰਿ ਕੌ ਹੇਰਤ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੫੦॥","translit_en":"taa dhin te par naar kau herat kabahoo(n) naeh ||50||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"‘The same determination is abiding in my mind and I will never attend to another’s woman.(50)(1)"},"pu":{"ss":"ਉਸ ਦਿਨ ਤੋਂ (ਮੈਂ ਕਿਸੇ) ਪਰਾਈ ਇਸਤਰੀ ਨੂੰ ਨਹੀਂ ਵੇਖਦਾ ॥੫੦॥"}}}],"nav":{"prev":9809,"next":9811}}

files.shabads/19/9812.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":9812,"source_id":"D","writer_id":47,"raag_id":63,"page_no":829,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":5,"first_verse_id":111133,"last_verse_id":111137,"source_english":"Dasam Bani","source_unicode":"ਦਸਮ ਬਾਣੀ","writer":"Guru Gobind Singh Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":null,"raag_unicode":null},"verses":[{"verse_id":111133,"page_no":829,"line_no":111133,"gurmukhi":"ਅੜਿਲ ॥","translit_en":"aRil ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Arril"},"pu":{"ss":"ਅੜਿਲ:"}}},{"verse_id":111134,"page_no":829,"line_no":111134,"gurmukhi":"ਬੰਦਿਸਾਲ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਸੁਤ ਕੋ ਦਿਯੋ ਪਠਾਇ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"ba(n)dhisaal nirap sut ko dhiyo paThai kai ||","translation":{"pu":{"ss":"ਰਾਜੇ ਨੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਪੁੱਤਰ ਨੂੰ ਬੰਦੀਖਾਨੇ ਵਿਚ ਭੇਜ ਦਿੱਤਾ।"}}},{"verse_id":111135,"page_no":829,"line_no":111135,"gurmukhi":"ਭੋਰ ਹੋਤ ਪੁਨ ਲਿਯੋ ਸੁ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਬੁਲਾਇ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"bhor hot pun liyo su nikaT bulai kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Raja sent his son to the jail and in the morning called him back."},"pu":{"ss":"ਸਵੇਰ ਹੋਣ ਤੇ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਫਿਰ ਆਪਣੇ ਕੋਲ ਬੁਲਾ ਲਿਆ।"}}},{"verse_id":111136,"page_no":829,"line_no":111136,"gurmukhi":"ਮੰਤ੍ਰੀ ਤਬ ਹੀ ਕਥਾ ਉਚਾਰੀ ਆਨਿ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"ma(n)tree tab hee kathaa uchaaree aan kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"-49"},"pu":{"ss":"ਮੰਤ੍ਰੀ ਨੇ ਤਦ ਹੀ ਆ ਕੇ ਕਥਾ ਉਚਾਰੀ।"}}},{"verse_id":111137,"page_no":829,"line_no":111137,"gurmukhi":"ਹੋ ਬਢ੍ਯੋ ਭੂਪ ਕੇ ਭਰਮ ਅਧਿਕ ਜਿਯ ਜਾਨਿ ਕੈ ॥੧॥","translit_en":"ho baddayo bhoop ke bharam adhik jiy jaan kai ||1||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Then the Minister narrated another anecdote and the Raja was further convinced.(1)"},"pu":{"ss":"(ਉਸ ਨੂੰ) ਚਿਤ ਵਿਚ ਚੰਗੀ ਤਰ੍ਰਹਾ ਜਾਣਨ ਤੇ ਰਾਜੇ ਦਾ ਭਰਮ ਵੱਧ ਗਿਆ (ਅਰਥਾਤ ਇਸਤਰੀ ਦੇ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਬਾਰੇ ਸ਼ੰਕਾ ਦ੍ਰਿੜ੍ਰਹ ਹੋ ਗਈ) ॥੧॥"}}}],"nav":{"prev":9811,"next":9813}}
files.shabads/19/9813.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":9813,"source_id":"D","writer_id":47,"raag_id":63,"page_no":829,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":5,"first_verse_id":111138,"last_verse_id":111142,"source_english":"Dasam Bani","source_unicode":"ਦਸਮ ਬਾਣੀ","writer":"Guru Gobind Singh Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":null,"raag_unicode":null},"verses":[{"verse_id":111138,"page_no":829,"line_no":111138,"gurmukhi":"ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥","translit_en":"dhoharaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Dohira"},"pu":{"ss":"ਦੋਹਰਾ:"}}},{"verse_id":111139,"page_no":829,"line_no":111139,"gurmukhi":"ਸਹਰ ਬਦਖਸਾ ਮੈ ਹੁਤੀ ਏਕ ਮੁਗਲ ਕੀ ਬਾਲ ॥","translit_en":"sahar badhakhasaa mai hutee ek mugal kee baal ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"There lived a Mughal’s woman m the city of Badkhashan."},"pu":{"ss":"ਬਦਖ਼ਸ਼ਾ (ਨਾ ਦੇ) ਸ਼ਹਿਰ ਵਿਚ ਇਕ ਮੁਗ਼ਲ ਇਸਤਰੀ ਰਹਿੰਦੀ ਸੀ।"}}},{"verse_id":111140,"page_no":829,"line_no":111140,"gurmukhi":"ਤਾ ਸੌ ਕਿਯਾ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਤਿਨ ਸੋ ਤੁਮ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਨ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ॥੨॥","translit_en":"taa sau kiyaa charitr tin so tum sunahu nirapaal ||2||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Now, my Raja, listen to the cunning acts of her plays.(2)"},"pu":{"ss":"ਉਸ ਨੇ ਜੋ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਕੀਤਾ, ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਹੇ ਰਾਜਨ! ਸੁਣੋ ॥੨॥"}}},{"verse_id":111141,"page_no":829,"line_no":111141,"gurmukhi":"ਬਿਤਨ ਮਤੀ ਇਕ ਚੰਚਲਾ ਹਿਤੂ ਮੁਗਲ ਕੀ ਏਕ ॥","translit_en":"bitan matee ik cha(n)chalaa hitoo mugal kee ek ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A lady named Bitan Mati loved the Mughal."},"pu":{"ss":"ਮੁਗ਼ਲ ਨਾਲ ਹਿਤ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲੀ ਬਿਤਨ ਮਤੀ (ਨਾ ਦੀ) ਇਕ ਇਸਤਰੀ ਸੀ।"}}},{"verse_id":111142,"page_no":829,"line_no":111142,"gurmukhi":"ਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਅਰੁ ਬਸੀਕਰ ਜਾਨਤ ਹੁਤੀ ਅਨੇਕ ॥੩॥","translit_en":"ja(n)tr ma(n)tr ar baseekar jaanat hutee anek ||3||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"She had been accorded with various types of magic and charms.(3)"},"pu":{"ss":"(ਉਹ) ਜੰਤ੍ਰ, ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਅਤੇ ਵਸ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲੇ ਅਨੇਕ ਢੰਗ ਜਾਣਦੀ ਹੁੰਦੀ ਸੀ ॥੩॥"}}}],"nav":{"prev":9812,"next":9814}}

files.shabads/19/9827.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":9827,"source_id":"D","writer_id":47,"raag_id":63,"page_no":830,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":5,"first_verse_id":111220,"last_verse_id":111224,"source_english":"Dasam Bani","source_unicode":"ਦਸਮ ਬਾਣੀ","writer":"Guru Gobind Singh Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":null,"raag_unicode":null},"verses":[{"verse_id":111220,"page_no":830,"line_no":111220,"gurmukhi":"ਅੜਿਲ ॥","translit_en":"aRil ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Arrii"},"pu":{"ss":"ਅੜਿਲ:"}}},{"verse_id":111221,"page_no":830,"line_no":111221,"gurmukhi":"ਮੋਹਿ ਮੀਰ ਜੋ ਕਹਿਯੋ ਸਤਿ ਮੋ ਜਾਨਿਯੋ ॥","translit_en":"moh meer jo kahiyo sat mo jaaniyo ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Quazi said, ‘Whatever Mughal told was true.’"},"pu":{"ss":"(ਕਾਜ਼ੀ ਕਹਿਣ ਲਗਾ ਕਿ) ਮੈਨੂੰ ਮੁਗ਼ਲ ਨੇ ਜੋ ਕਹਿਆ ਹੈ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਸਚ ਸਮਝੋ।"}}},{"verse_id":111222,"page_no":830,"line_no":111222,"gurmukhi":"ਤਾ ਦਿਨ ਤੇ ਤਿਨ ਮੁਗਲ ਹਿਤੂ ਕਰ ਮਾਨਿਯੋ ॥","translit_en":"taa dhin te tin mugal hitoo kar maaniyo ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"From then on he created close friendship with the Mughal."},"pu":{"ss":"ਉਸ ਦਿਨ ਤੋਂ ਉਸ ਮੁਗ਼ਲ ਨੂੰ ਆਪਣਾ ਮਿਤਰ ਬਣਾ ਲਿਆ।"}}},{"verse_id":111223,"page_no":830,"line_no":111223,"gurmukhi":"ਤਵਨ ਦਿਵਸ ਤੇ ਕਾਜੀ ਚੇਰੋ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਰਹਿਯੋ ॥","translit_en":"tavan dhivas te kaajee chero havai rahiyo ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Rather he became his disciple and acquiesced that whatever Mughal"},"pu":{"ss":"ਉਸ ਦਿਨ ਤੋਂ ਉਹ ਕਾਜ਼ੀ ਉਸ ਦਾ ਚੇਲਾ ਬਣ ਗਿਆ"}}},{"verse_id":111224,"page_no":830,"line_no":111224,"gurmukhi":"ਹੋ ਸਤਿ ਬਚਨ ਸੋਊ ਭਯੋ ਜੁ ਮੋ ਕੋ ਇਨ ਕਹਿਯੋ ॥੨੬॥","translit_en":"ho sat bachan souoo bhayo ju mo ko in kahiyo ||26||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Said it was correct.(26)"},"pu":{"ss":"ਅਤੇ (ਕਹਿਣ ਲਗਾ ਕਿ) ਉਹ ਬੋਲ ਸੱਚਾ ਸਿੱਧ ਹੋਇਆ ਜੋ ਮੈਨੂੰ ਇਸ ਨੇ ਕਿਹਾ ਸੀ ॥੨੬॥"}}}],"nav":{"prev":9826,"next":9828}}
